messages:
vikram: Quick follow-up on the RFC for seedless resume handshake + operator fallback. Link: https://go.redwood.rfc/airgap-handshake
vikram: TL;DR: propose per-activation short-lived transfer tokens + manifest-level chunk receipts. Want consensus on operator override UX.
elaine: Skimming. How do we ensure verifier doesn't block operator during partial imports? Operators need a 'force-accept-incomplete' for emergencies.
vikram: Plan: verifier strict-by-default. Operator override via signed admin action + audit log. Overrides emit event so Console shows 'partial-apply (override)'.
olivia_k: Concern: signed admin action needs local key access in air-gapped envs. Need HSM path. Also avoid support noise: add clearer operator messaging.
mike: For resumable transfers, index-first + chunk receipts with seq numbers so fetch can resume after cut. Also include blob-size hints.
elaine: Agree on chunk receipts. Add backpressure hint from operator->transport to limit IO windows for constrained sites.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout for cluster staging-airgap-12 — manifest v2.3 -> v2.4
deploy-bot: fetch-phase 12% @1.2MB/s; resume_token=sha256:abc123def456...
olivia_k: UX: Console should show 'resumable checkpoints' + last-successful-seq. Add API: GET /v1/airgap/checkpoint?cluster=staging-airgap-12
mike: Security: require per-component signatures (not just bundle-level) so operator can skip non-critical component if needed.
vikram: Decision candidate: require per-component sig + aggregate manifest sig. Overrides allowed only for non-security-critical components. I'll draft RFC addendum.
elaine: :thumbsup: Add playbook snippet for CLI force-accept. Example:
```bash
redwoodctl airgap apply --force-accept component=telemetry --reason='ops remediation' --signed-by admin@corp
```
We need emitted audit-id.
olivia_k: Also add HSM flow: `--hsm-key=slot-3` and env var for offline signing agent. Doc for key custody required.
mike: Action items: 1) chunk-receipt PR (@vikram) 2) console checkpoint UI (@olivia_k) 3) admin-override playbook (@elaine) 4) security review per-component sigs (@mike). Timeline: initial PRs by EOD Fri?
vikram: SG. I'll file PR and ping arch-review. Thanks all.
